title: Egocentric Robots in a Human-Centric World? Exploring Group-Robot-Interaction in Public Spaces
reasoning: The paper focuses on human-robot interaction (HRI) and perceived extraversion in public spaces. While it uses LLMs (GPT-3.5 and Llama-2) to power its dialogue system and mentions social norms/conventions, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
